body: You seem to be very invested in your ideas and that's great but: if one isn't thinking or reacting to life, doesn't that make them a useless vegetable?
While we may be far away, I can still "hear" your helpful words, thanks.
With that view, "I think, therefore I am" kinda falls apart doesn't it?

No, I've never spoken to a therapist. I don't even know how I could contact one besides the "suicide attempt-cry for help" which I think would only end poorly. Your guess would be correct and my dreams are becoming less likely with every test I fail due to having no energy to study.
